metadata.name: Project data example
metadata.description: Read and write existing Project records through this plugin’s OAuth connection
metadata.permission: Read and save records in your selected Project, or soft-delete and restore them

help: Choose an existing project and table to read and save business records manually.
unconfigured: This example has no OAuth application connected. Use the isolated preview; a live connection needs separate authorization acceptance.
replaceWarning: Saving replaces the entire JSON object. Keep unchanged fields. A later save from another device overwrites this value.
trashNote: The service returns trash in one response, without pagination.
empty: This page has no records. Create one or go to the previous page.
emptyTrash: Trash is empty. Soft-deleted records appear here.
idle: Enter an existing project, load its tables, then choose a table.
knownReadFailed: The write succeeded, but reloading failed. Read the records manually to check.
invalid: Check the project, table, record ID, page and JSON object (up to 64 KiB).
scopeDenied: The plugin lacks a required read or write scope. Ask the application owner to check its OAuth authorization.
permissionDenied: Network permission is missing. Check http.fetch under the installed plugin’s permissions.
notFound: The project or record is missing, or your account has no access. Check the selected project and its permissions.
collectionGone: The record’s table was deleted. This record cannot be restored.
kbExcluded: This table contains knowledge-base fields. Choose a table without knowledge-base integration to modify records in this example.
networkFailed: Reading failed. Check the connection and authorization, then read manually.
invalidResponse: The response does not match the selected project or record. Stop writing and check the connection.
unknown: The result of this write is unknown. Read records and trash to check whether it completed; do not retry directly.
verify: Read records and trash to check
acknowledge: I have checked the result of this write
review: Review both lists and other record pages. Confirm only after checking this write.
noTables: This project has no available table. Prepare an existing table in Wainao first.
denied: The operation did not complete. Check the connection or ask the project administrator about permissions.
